required_rust.registries: Merge ALL source-authored registries by champion, slot, form, source precedence and explicit exceptions; emit complete public filtered kit descriptors to client from same server authoring authority; do not silently expose incomplete kits.
required_rust.wire: One typed action per authenticated actor+slot with shape target_any / target_enemy / target_ally / line_enemy / cone_enemy / self / point / recast; explicit handling of Ahri E and Nami W. Do not convert unsupported shapes to skill.ground or directional blindly.
required_rust.authorization: Derive seat/owner/5 units on Rust game-server; validate target team, fog, realm, range, rank, CC, phase and resource server-side; return public DTO whitelist, no enemy state or RNG.
required_rust.concurrency: Atomic admission before seal and single primary spell intent per slot/cast_instance; idempotent request IDs; reject competing queue or explicit versioned replacement; retire stale target/board pending when one wins; genuine fresh W after cooldown allowed; authored recasts preserve their own transitions.
required_rust.economics: Charge mana/cooldown once on real cast; gateway rejection leaves no pending intent, action receipt, or resource mutation; ACK replay identical after reconnect.
required_rust.public_client: GUI reads only filtered Rust-issued descriptors; targeted input enabled for target_any with team validation; generated request is routed to the same authored Rust executor as internal combo/board/targeted.
